newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH JUNE CORE INFLATION RISES 0.8 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH JUNE CORE INFLATION RISES 0.8 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish core inflation rose 0.2 percent in June on May and the year-on-year rise was 0.8 percent, Statictics Finland said in a statement on Friday.
The mean of six economists' forecast for the June core inflation rate had been for a 0.7 percent rise in a 0.5-0.8 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- its chief gauge for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
